name: billion-context
description: Compresses context in a local proxy between an agent and its model API, so very long sessions keep going, with a Claude Code plugin.

skills.name: Compress ranges
skills.description: Folds a range of earlier messages into a detailed summary, freeing context for the rest of the session.

skills.name: Restore and search
skills.description: Restores a compressed range when exact details are needed and searches compressed summaries by keyword.
